Not in the same way. Luxury Presence is primarily a website builder and marketing platform. They include social media management in upper plans and sell it as an add-on to others, but their focus is websites, IDX and CRM tools.

Partly. Luxury Presence's social media management includes AI-generated Reels made from your listings.

Multiple customers have reported being told they would lose their website if they canceled their Luxury Presence subscription.
